Subject: Redwood demo — quick recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for hopping on the call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Key takeaways you shared: high-value use cases are 1) customer support summarization, 2) internal knowledge search, and 3) realtime assistant for agents.
- Performance targets you mentioned: avg. 200ms p95 for gen flows, and embeddings latency < 50ms for search.
- Current constraints: strict data residency for PII, procurement window targeting mid-July, and security questionnaire required by procurement.

What I'm sending with this email: 
- redwood-demo-summary.pdf (screenshots + configuration we demoed)
- pricing-sheet.xlsx (starter config + reserved capacity options)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft timeline & owners)

Tentative next steps we agreed on:
1) Rishi to run a quick technical feasibility call with your infra/engineering team (30-45m). Can you share 2x time slots?
2) Procurement to review security questionnaire -- Samira, I sent the initial pack in a separate note; happy to loop in our security SME.
3) We'll update the MAP with milestone dates once you confirm the procurement target.

If your priority/timing has shifted with EoQ coming up, let me know -- we can compress milestones or provide a short pilot path to align with July approvals.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
